title: 【男のロマン】工場の金型が「変形合体ロボ」に進化した瞬間
prompt: Japanese mecha anime style, high-quality 2D cel animation. A heavy industrial injection mold sits in a dimly lit factory. Suddenly, it begins a dynamic mechanical transformation. Metal blocks slide, rotate, and interlock with intense sparks and steam effects. The mold reconfigures into a sleek, powerful warrior robot. The robot strikes a dramatic heroic pose with glowing eyes. High contrast, vibrant colors, speed lines, dramatic camera angle.

title: 【予算崩壊】金型メーカーが本気で「SF映画」を作った結果がヤバい
prompt: Cinematic Hollywood movie scene, epic sci-fi. A massive, highly detailed industrial injection mold floats in deep space, reflecting sunlight and distant stars. It begins a complex mechanical transformation. Heavy metal plates shift, gears turn, and thrusters emerge, releasing bursts of blue plasma energy. It reconfigures into a sleek, armored spaceship. The ship blasts off, flying rapidly past a giant planet and asteroids. 8k photorealistic, highly detailed textures, lens flare, dramatic orbital lighting, wide aspect ratio.

title: 【閲覧注意】最新の金型から「リアルすぎる美女」が生まれて踊り出した...
prompt: Hollywood blockbuster sci-fi style. A pristine, brightly lit futuristic factory floor flooded with daylight and white LED illumination. A massive, state-of-the-art injection molding machine slowly opens, releasing clouds of clean white steam. Revealed inside is a newly molded, hyper-realistic female android with flawless synthetic skin and subtle metallic details at her joints. As she steps out into the light, she immediately performs a sharp, energetic, trendy viral dance routine (modern pop/hip-hop choreography) with perfect mechanical precision. Dynamic camera tracking, 8k resolution, highly detailed textures, photorealistic, cinematic lighting.

title: 【神回】金型から「究極のアイドル」を射出成形してみたwwww
prompt: High-budget commercial style. A pristine, brightly lit futuristic factory floor flooded with daylight and white LED illumination. A massive, state-of-the-art injection molding machine slowly opens, releasing clouds of clean white steam and glittering particles. Revealed inside is a newly molded, incredibly cute Japanese teenage idol. She features flawless skin, a beaming smile, and is wearing a highly detailed, colorful frilly stage costume with ribbons. As she steps out into the light, she immediately performs a super catchy, energetic Kawaii dance routine (J-Pop choreography) with perfect precision. Dynamic camera tracking, 8k resolution, highly detailed textures, photorealistic, bright and vivid colors.

title: 【ジョジョ風】金型に「スタンド能力」が発現したようですッ！
prompt: H80s retro manga art style video. Heavy black ink outlines, detailed cross-hatching shading, and high-contrast dramatic lighting. A menacing atmosphere fills a dark industrial factory. A massive metal injection molding die sits heavily on the floor. Suddenly, supernatural purple and gold energy erupts from the mold. The metal parts shift, crack, and reconfigure rapidly in a mechanical metamorphosis. From the transforming metal emerges a powerful, muscular humanoid spirit entity. Its armored body is intricately designed with industrial mold plates, gears, and ejector pins. The entity strikes an exaggerated, artistic high-fashion pose. A psychedelic aura of unnatural colors swirls around it. Floating, jagged Japanese sound effect text appears on screen. The camera angle is low and dramatic, emphasizing power.

title: 【霹靂一閃】金型が「雷の呼吸」で世界新記録を叩き出した件
prompt: Cinematic sports broadcast style. The Olympic 100m sprint final in a massive stadium. At the starting line, among human athletes, sits a huge, heavy industrial injection molding metal die. The starting gun fires.Instantly, the metal block transforms into a young swordsman figure with bright golden hair, wearing a traditional Japanese haori jacket patterned with yellow and orange triangles. He crouches low, hand on a sword hilt, surrounded by crackling yellow electricity.In a blinding flash of lightning and a deafening thunderclap, he vanishes, moving at god-like speed invisible to the naked eye. A trail of golden light tears down the track. He reappears instantly past the finish line, sword already resheathed. The scoreboard flashes NEW WORLD RECORD: 0.001 SEC. The crowd is stunned.

title: 【KICK BACK】金型の悪魔 vs 工場のヒーロー、激突。
prompt: Shonen action anime style, high-quality animation. An industrial factory district under a cloudy sky. In the center sits a massive, heavy steel injection molding die. Suddenly, with a flash of energy, the metal die mechanically unfolds and transforms into a giant Mold Robot – a towering entity made of heavy metal plates, gears, and steam. Facing it is a cool hero wearing a white dress shirt and a black tie. He features a unique mechanical helmet design resembling utility knife blades (box cutters), and large cutter blades emerge from his gauntlets. The hero dashes with high speed to clash with the giant robot. Bright sparks fly as metal hits metal in a dynamic, stylish battle sequence. No gore, just intense mechanical action. Cinematic camera angles, dramatic lighting.

title: 【バルス】森に捨てられた金型が「古代兵器」になってビーム撃ってきた
prompt: Classic Japanese hand-drawn cel animation style with painterly watercolor backgrounds featuring lush nature and towering clouds. A massive, aged industrial metal injection molding die, heavily covered in moss and rust, sits in a grassy meadow. It slowly, mechanically transforms with clunky gears into a tall, ancient automaton robot with long, multi-jointed arms and a round, domed head with small lens-like eyes (resembling a forgotten guardian of an ancient civilization). The robot stands solemnly and fires a powerful, devastating beam of red energy from its face lenses, creating a massive explosion in the distant landscape. The atmosphere is nostalgic, gentle, yet melancholic. Wide cinematic shot.

title: 【サービスサービス】汎用人型決戦兵器 vs 射出成形金型（使徒）
prompt: Classic 90s Japanese mecha anime style, cel animation texture with high contrast. In a fortified futuristic city at sunset. A massive steel injection molding die sits on the street. Instantly, it mechanically twists and morphs into a bizarre, towering abstract geometric enemy with a glowing red core. Charging at it is a slender, blue-armored bio-mechanical humanoid weapon with a single glowing eye lens. The blue mech moves with heavy weight, wielding a glowing vibro-blade, slashing at the metal enemy. Hexagonal orange light barriers ripple upon impact. Debris flies. Intense, dramatic atmosphere.
